repo_and_data_irregularities.finding: Initial Commit 1430b4f Contained Only a 7-Byte Stub README.md ('# Jack2') With Missing Trailing Newline and Zero Prior Property/Lease Files
repo_and_data_irregularities.impact_and_resolution: Audited commit 1430b4f line-by-line: no prior datasets, lease abstracts, or website code existed. Built full verified dataset, projection engine, and dashboard from scratch without inventing missing parcel facts.

repo_and_data_irregularities.finding: Initial Commit 1430b4f Git Author Metadata Used a Non-Noreply Personal Email ([REDACTED-EMAIL-01])
repo_and_data_irregularities.impact_and_resolution: Per strict privacy mandate, the discovered email is kept strictly internal-only, never printed anywhere in data/docs/site, replaced with placeholder [REDACTED-EMAIL-01], and blocked by automated PII checks in verify_all.py. Subsequent agent commits use GitHub's users.noreply.github.com address.
repo_and_data_irregularities.source_label: GitHub Official Docs — Setting Commit Email Privacy

repo_and_data_irregularities.finding: Task Brief Mentions 'session-<id>/<task>' Branches vs. Arena Platform Fixed-Branch Enforcement ('arena/a3a8ec08-jack2')
repo_and_data_irregularities.impact_and_resolution: Platform rules strictly bind session tracking to 'arena/a3a8ec08-jack2' and prohibit creating/pushing other branches. Documented in COORDINATION.md; non-overlapping file scopes were maintained on 'arena/a3a8ec08-jack2' prior to PR integration to 'main'.

repo_and_data_irregularities.finding: October 2025 Los Angeles Area CPI-U Values Missing Due to 2025 Federal Lapse in Appropriations
repo_and_data_irregularities.impact_and_resolution: BLS officially notes October 2025 CPI observations were not collected due to the 2025 appropriations lapse. Gap is preserved transparently without artificial interpolation.
repo_and_data_irregularities.source_label: U.S. BLS — Consumer Price Index, Los Angeles Area (Jan 2026 Release Footnote)

repo_and_data_irregularities.finding: BEA Discontinued Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) GDP & Personal Income Releases Starting Feb 5, 2026
repo_and_data_irregularities.impact_and_resolution: With Release BEA 26-08 (Feb 5, 2026), BEA ceased publishing MSA-level GDP/Personal Income and consolidated reporting at the county level (LA County Personal Income = $818.5B). County-level official series used accordingly.
repo_and_data_irregularities.source_label: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Release 26-08
